entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: His love for humans and the desire to[n]save them elevated him to a god-like[n]being...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Despite the many fortunes of fate, I did[n]not anticipate such a result.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Maruki was dead serious about saving[n]humanity.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Even though he was fighting for what[n]he believed in, having to go against[n]us must have torn him up inside.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Opposing the very people you wish to[n]save... Humans are such complicated[n]creatures.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hey, Sojiro... Would you be happy if[n]you could see Mom again?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What's this all of a sudden? Of course...[n]There are a lot of things I'd like to say[n]to her.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Yeah. Same here.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: But, knowing her... She might get cranky[n]if we grabbed her attention just because[n]we missed her.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Cranky?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, y'know. She'd snap back about how[n]she "doesn't want to be distracted for no[n]reason." Never mind OUR reason.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: That's why I plan on livin' life to the[n]fullest—so when I see her again, I'll[n]have a lifetime of stories to tell.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It might not be today, or tomorrow,[n]but someday, when the time is right...[n]I'm sure she'll greet us with a smile.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't you think?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Yeah!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You know, I never did have a chance to[n]give my thanks to Dr. Maruki...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Your thanks?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mhm. For giving me some more time[n]with my father, even if it didn't last.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I still don't think what he did was right,[n]but... I can't say I wasn't happy.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Haru-senpai...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I never got to thank him either. I hope[n]we'll get a chance to do that one day.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yes... Me too.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hey, Sis... Do you ever wonder what it[n]would be like if Dad were still alive?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Why are you asking me this?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: U-Um, never mind! Forget I said[n]anything, okay?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I try not to dwell on what could have been.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: However... Now and then, I do find[n]myself thinking "what would Dad say?"

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Really...!?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Is it that shocking?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It's not as if I resent him. His lifestyle,[n]while dangerous, played a valuable role...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Hm... I suppose my views have changed[n]a bit since we last spoke about this, huh?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So... Dr. Maruki took our deepest[n]desires and made them reality, right?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Precisely.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But even with the ability to observe[n]others' cognition, I'm surprised he was[n]able to fulfill our wishes so flawlessly...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This might be a self-centered way to[n]look at it, but... Maybe he felt so bad[n]for us that our pain was his own.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...I don't want his efforts to go to waste.[n]Let's live our lives to the fullest.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Wow, that thing is enormous. Not to[n]mention it looks like it's made of solid[n]gold.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...It won't start moving, will it?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Oh come on, that would be awesome![n]Like a giant robot of justice!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I don't exactly think of justice when I[n]look at it...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Whether it's on the side of justice or[n]evil, we can agree it is a sight to behold.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I didn't have time to think about this[n]while we were fighting, but...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Is it normal for a Persona to get so large?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Under most circumstances? Definitely[n]not. If I had to guess, I'd say it was his[n]own reality that made this possible.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: He could make anything he wished for[n]come true, yeah? That was insane, man.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It was. We've fought a lot of battles, but[n]our victory in this one was nothing short[n]of a miracle.
